products.name: Braintrust
products.note: Evaluation-first LLM platform; datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, prompt iteration with production trace feedback

profile_text.body:
Braintrust is a San Francisco-based AI observability platform founded in 2022. The company describes itself as providing tools for tracing production systems, running evaluations, and catching regressions before they reach users, with a stated focus on helping teams ship quality AI agents at scale. Its approach centers on surfacing patterns automatically so that teams can evaluate AI behavior against expectations and iterate continuously.

The core product, also called Braintrust, is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management platform. It combines datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, and prompt iteration informed by production trace feedback. The platform includes a feature called Loop, which the company describes as generating better prompts, scorers, and datasets automatically based on what a user wants to optimize. Braintrust also offers an MCP server that connects a coding agent to a user's AI stack, allowing logs to be queried, evaluations to be run, and prompts to be updated directly from an IDE.

The site's held facts show 174 law exposure entries associated with California, though no specific cases or litigation details are on record. Braintrust has a verified presence in this reference registry as of August 2026.
